goal_objective: Stabilize and simplify the disposable bounded-prompt test controller without candidate or audit churn, then continue autonomously until one unchanged frozen architecture completes two consecutive clean 291-call qualification matrices across GPT-5.4 mini xhigh, GPT-5.4 mini medium, and GPT-5.6 Luna medium. Use a newly created test-taker task/thread for every invocation; preserve every failure; allow no retries, replacements, best-of, missing or invalid cells; and require exact durable independently reopened evidence.

role_model.main: GPT-5.6 Sol max owns architecture, state machine, trust boundary, churn decisions, integration, freeze/launch authority, evidence adjudication, and qualification
role_model.medium: fresh GPT-5.6 Sol medium agents own narrow mechanical inventories, hashes, fixtures, simulator execution, receipts, schemas, manifests, and Git verification
role_model.xhigh: fresh GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh agents own bounded diagnosis, component implementation, falsification, regression review, and holistic review
role_model.writer_rule: one writer per component; no subagent may weaken acceptance, authorize launch, mint readiness, or declare Goal completion

stabilization.repair_policy: new create-only internal iteration, preserve failed iteration, batch full exit gate, never candidate-per-finding

trusted: outer controller and controlled host pinned to pushed Git bytes
data-only frozen manifest for 97 semantic cells, three routes, exact rendered prompts, scorer/oracle/reducer identities, and 291 schedule
one small standalone controller with simulate, run-canary, run-matrix, reopen
create-only attempt.json before dispatch, raw_result.json, and completion.json last with deterministic score binding
one small offline verifier for bundle identity, schedule completeness, global task/thread/turn/nonce freshness, result integrity, deterministic score, and accounting
foreground controller owns start, wait to terminal, full output capture, scoring, completion persistence, and reopen
durable attempt is once-only; started row without valid final seal permanently invalidates run
explicit_nonblocking_residuals: arbitrary in-process Python callers invoking private helpers
blocking_facts: complete raw output and terminal metadata
zero retries or replacements or best-of

assessment_times: before review, candidate, freeze, canary, or launch
persist: predecessor FAIL and successor PASS receipts
progress_only_if: trusted or public surface is deleted or replaced
not_progress: new files or tests or hashes
declare_churn_if: two assessments show no prefix, closure, blocker, or surface progress
repair adds facade, callback, token, recursive verifier, sibling bypass, or repair-only bookkeeping
candidate or audit proposed before exit
same action proposed on unchanged premises
loop_breaker.on_churn: keep Goal active; pause empirical phases; preserve evidence; build one max-owned fault tree; delete, replace, or simplify smallest component; no identical retry

stabilization_exit_gate: two complete clean-directory synthetic 291-cell traversals on unchanged bytes
every normalized v8-v21 regression predecessor FAIL and stabilized PASS

fault cases: immediate completion, yielded multi-poll, nonzero exit, missing or partial output, attempt-only crash, abrupt or ordered stop and drain, render drift, illegal advance, deterministic score recompute, restart reopen, terminal accounting
exact minimal surface and zero runtime import from candidate v12-v21 control code
holistic independent Sol xhigh review with zero experiment-validity blockers under stated trust boundary
stabilized bytes committed and pushed with local HEAD equal fetched origin/main
post_exit_sequence: three-route zero-credit canary with three new tasks

actions: fetch and verify local HEAD equals origin/main

communication: parent only for external decision blocker, controller-family reset, pushed candidate entering empirical testing, complete clean matrix, or final qualification
